text_elements.text: WARNING: Shut off high voltage circuit. Refer to GI-33, "How to Disconnect High Voltage".
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Remove Li-ion battery. Refer to EVB-194, "Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Remove battery pack upper case. Refer to EVB-204, "BATTERY PACK UPPER CASE : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: 2.CHECK CONTINUITY LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER AND HEATER RELAY UNIT
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Remove service plug switch bracket. Refer to  EVB-217, "BATTERY JUNCTION BOX AND BATTERY HARNESS : Exploded View".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Disconnect Li-ion battery controller harness connector and heater relay unit harness connector.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check continuity Li-ion battery controller harness connector and heater relay unit harness connector.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: 3.CHECK CONTINUITY LI-ION BATTERY AND HEATER RELAY UNIT
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Check continuity Li-ion battery harness connector and heater relay unit harness connector.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: 4.CHECK CONTINUITY HEATER RELAY UNIT AND LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Check continuity heater relay unit harness connector and Li-ion battery controller harness connector.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: YES >> Replace to shown in the below.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Li-ion battery controller. Refer to EVB-214, "LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Heater relay unit. Refer to EVB-234, "LI-ION BATTERY HEATER RELAY UNIT : Disassembly and Assembly".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Power switch ON and wait for 10 seconds or more.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: DANGER: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Be sure to remove the service plug in order to disconnect the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The removed service plug must always be carried in a pocket of the responsible worker or placed in the tool box during the procedure to prevent the plug from being connected by mistake.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Be sure to wear insulating protective equipment consisting of glove, shoes, face shield and glasses before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Never allow workers other than the responsible person to touch the vehicle containing high voltage parts. To keep others from touching the high voltage parts, these parts must be covered with an insulating sheet except when using them.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: CAUTION: Never  bring  the  vehicle  into  the  READY  status  with  the  service  plug  removed  unless  otherwise instructed in the Service Manual. A malfunction may occur if this is not observed.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: WARNING: Disconnect the high voltage. Refer to GI-33, "How to Disconnect High Voltage".
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Remove Li-ion battery. Refer to EVB-194, "Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Remove battery pack upper case. Refer to EVB-204, "BATTERY PACK UPPER CASE : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: YES >> Replace all battery temperature sensor.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: NO >> Replace applicable battery temperature sensor.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Remove battery temperature sensor. Refer to  EVB-235,  "FRONT MODULE STACK : Exploded View" (Front module stack) or EVB-251, "REAR MODULE STACK : Exploded View" (Rear module stack).
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check resistance between battery temperature sensor terminals.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check the indication of the Li-ion battery available charge gauge.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Is the lighting status 1 Segment or none?
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Set the vehicle, according to the following conditions.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Let the Li-ion battery discharge until the Li-ion battery available charge gauge shows segment 1 or below.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Charge the Li-ion battery by normal charge until the level reaches full charge.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: After  the  completion  of  normal  charge,  check  that  the  indication  of  the  Li-ion  battery  available  charge gauge shows 12 segments.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Power switch ON and wait for 10 seconds or more.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: 1.CHECK DATA MONITOR OR FREEZE FRAME DATA (FFD)
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: When a sudden voltage fluctuation is detected in module.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Check to see if there is a cell voltage which largely differ from the others.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: YES >> Replace corresponding Module. Refer to EVB-235, "FRONT MODULE STACK : Exploded View".
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: If abnormal cell is not identified, perform DTC confirmation procedure. Refer to EVB-169, "DTC Logic".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check cell voltage again using 'DATA MONITOR' or 'FFD' to identify malfunctioning cell.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: >> Replace corresponding Module. Refer to EVB-235, "FRONT MODULE STACK : Exploded View".
text_elements.label: text
